results.correct_value: loss_ft null (1,820 ft is one party's day-1 loss; the round trip must lose far more)
results.evidence: Rule 4. The route is an out-and-back from the Bacon Creek road end: the USGS elevation service gives ~783 ft at the row's road-end pin and ~6,427 ft at its summit pin, so returning to the car must lose at least ~5,600 ft, and the ascent record that is the origin of 1,820 gives it as the day-1 loss only (road over the summit to a camp beyond). The row's own itinerary loses 5,300 ft on day 2 alone. No source states a car-to-car loss, so loss_ft is cleared rather than replaced.

results.fact: Total round-trip gain and loss (gain_ft 6,550 vs itinerary 5,600)
results.evidence: gain_ft 6,550 is one party's day-1 figure (road over the summit to camp), while the itinerary/totalNote say 5,600 ft round trip, which is barely above the ~5,640 ft net rise measured by the USGS elevation service and ignores the intermediate loss the ascent record describes. A second itinerary (search excerpt only) gives +5,450 ft over 6.5 mi on day 1, disagreeing with 6,550. The forum reports that might settle it are not archived or would not load. No stated round-trip total, so nothing patched.

results.fact: Day-1 gain to the Berdeen Lake camp stated in the bivy entry
results.evidence: The bivy note's 'four thousand feet of gain' is below the net rise from the road end (~783 ft by USGS) to a lake camp at 5,016 ft or above. But the two day-1 figures found disagree (+6,550 ft in one ascent record; +5,450 ft in a second itinerary seen only as a search excerpt), so no replacement is agreed. Rewording to drop the number is possible under rule 4 but the camp it describes (lake benches vs high camp) is itself unsettled, so left.

results.fact: Maximum ice difficulty on the route (gear[0] 'WI4/95°' vs grade/ice_grade/pitch_detail WI5)
results.evidence: The first-ascent account grades the route IV+ 5.9 WI5 mixed. An independent later ascent report (read via an archive copy of the forum thread) describes the crux as a full 60 m of near-vertical to vertical ice and grades it WI5. One photo-essay page gives 'IV AI4', a single dissent that does not meet the two-source bar for a range. grade, ice_grade and pitch_detail already say WI5; only gear[0] is changed.

What should change: approach_logistics.trailhead/trailheadLat/trailheadLng/trailheadDirection and waypoint 0 re-pointed to the Denny Creek trailhead (coordinates too), and waypoints 1-6 (Source Lake junction, stream crossing, gully passage, Thumbtack, Bryant-Chair gully) removed from this route or moved to the Alpental variant — they trace the secondary gully line.
